## When No Recipe Fits

Recipes show the common shapes. When a request needs something none of them shows, build it from the sections above instead of guessing.

- Start from the closest recipes' code, and note exactly what they leave out.
- Name the parts the gap touches (where rows live, the value path, the cell template, bindings and events, sorting and filtering, changing rows) and reread those sections.

For example, preset date buttons with the active one highlighted combine three sections: events with param, a constraint on the date field, and a class bound to a Record of flags. The preset-buttons variant of narrow-the-table-from-controls is that combination, built from these rules.
